cohort: Existing 80 D2 development participants only, including the 16 former calibration participants
family: D2 XGBoost histogram multi-output trees, fixed D2 hyperparameters and participant-balanced pseudo-Huber loss
offset: Current glucose for all dynamic variants; training participant-macro target mean for static-only. Static-only never receives current glucose.
dynamic: Unchanged 21 D2 CGM features plus 12 causal prefix features; prefix values gated by existing warm eligibility
static: One earliest-recording historical profile per participant; age, sex, diabetes duration, smoking history, alcohol history, coarse source-text medication contexts
excluded: All labs; undated anthropometry and diagnosis/complication summaries; recording hypoglycemia outcome; identifiers; synthetic EHR
negative_control: Complete static profiles deranged between training participants once per fold; validation profiles correctly linked
preprocessing: Dynamic D2 train-only preprocessor; numeric static medians on unique training profiles; training-only one-hot categories; explicit numeric and categorical missingness
primary: Equal-participant macro MAE at 120 minutes; all horizons reported
support_rule: All four fused-minus-dynamic MAEs negative and all four paired participant-bootstrap upper bounds below zero, plus 120m fused-minus-shuffled upper bound below zero
permutation_importance: One deterministic validation perturbation per modality per fold; static whole-profile derangement within validation, dynamic complete-row permutation within each validation participant
spike: Optional unchanged D2 incident labels and forecast trajectory ranking only; no fitting or threshold/calibration changes
stopping: One fixed five-variant five-fold run, no tuning after results
